name: Nasu Kohgen Beer
about: Nasu Kohgen Beer is a brewery with a shop and restaurant in Nasu, a highland resort in northern Tochigi. It opened in the autumn of 1996 and brews with snowmelt water from the Nasu mountains.

Its best-known beer, Ai, takes its name from Princess Aiko, whose emblem is the white azalea that grows wild near the imperial villa in Nasu. The brewery also makes Nine-Tailed Fox, a strong barley wine sold as dated vintages, and says it was the first Japanese brewery to win awards at three World Beer Cups in a row.
